The '''TX-2020''' was a model of [[Laser cannon/Legends|double laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] It was an anti-vehicle laser emplacement used for protecting bases and installations. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] base [[Dalgeer's Rim]] used a concealed TX-2020 as part of its defensive setup. The emplacement was protected by a pair of [[shield door]]s and was recessed into the rim of a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] caldera.<ref name="HS" />
